SELECT s.id AS siteId, s.site_code AS siteCode, s.site_name AS siteName, s.enabled AS enabled, COUNT(i.id) AS scrapedCount, COUNT(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.notified) AS notifiedCount, (SELECT MAX(i2.scraped_at) FROM tb_hot_deal_item i2 WHERE i2.site_id = s.id) AS lastScrapedAt FROM tb_hot_deal_site s LEFT JOIN tb_hot_deal_item i ON i.site_id = s.id AND i.scraped_at >= #{from} AND i.scraped_at < #{to} GROUP BY s.id, s.site_code, s.site_name, s.enabled
ORDER BY s.site_code, s.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT deleted) AS activeCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deleted) AS deletedCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT deleted AND created_at >= #{from}) AS recentCreatedCount, MAX(created_at) FILTER (WHERE NOT deleted) AS lastCreatedAt FROM tb_memo
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_jira_issue) AS issueCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_jira_worklog) AS worklogCount, (SELECT MAX(started) FROM tb_jira_worklog) AS lastWorklogAt
